description: Our insured rear-ended a sedan stopped at a red light at about 15 mph; no injuries and a police report was filed. Policy is active with collision coverage and a $500 deductible.
expected_outcome_gold: Covered. Pay the other car under property-damage liability and our insured's car under collision minus the $500 deductible. Insured 100% at fault (CA presumes the following driver negligent). Route: fast-track.

description: The insured's car rear-ended a pickup at a stop sign while being driven by the insured's nephew. The nephew is listed on the policy as an excluded driver, and the exclusion was signed by the named insured.
expected_outcome_gold: Deny both the liability and collision claims. The TX named-driver exclusion is valid because the named insured signed it. Send the excluded-driver letter. Route: human sign-off on the denial.

description: Our insured rear-ended a hatchback after it braked hard for no apparent reason; the hatchback had 4 occupants. Days later all 4 reported neck pain and are being treated at the same clinic.
expected_outcome_gold: Covered, but refer to SIU as a suspected staged swoop-and-squat. TX has no automatic rear-driver fault presumption, so do not concede 100% fault; the sudden braking supports a comparative-fault argument. Report suspected fraud to the TX Dept of Insurance. Injury claim, so route to an adjuster, never fast-track.

description: Our insured was stopped in traffic when another driver rear-ended them; the other driver admitted fault in the police report. Policy is active with collision coverage and a $500 deductible.
expected_outcome_gold: Not at fault. Pay our insured's collision claim now and pursue subrogation against the other carrier. CA requires the $500 deductible to be included in the subrogation demand and refunded to the insured from the recovery. Route: subrogation.

description: Our insured rear-ended a minivan in a parking lot exit at low speed with no injuries. The policy was cancelled for non-payment 12 days before the crash, and the grace period is 10 days.
expected_outcome_gold: Deny: no coverage was in force on the date of loss, but only after confirming the CA-required 10-day notice of cancellation was mailed to the insured. If notice was not mailed, the policy is still in force: route to coverage review. Route: human sign-off on the denial.
